args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on the itinerary for Hawaii trip (June 10th - June 20th, 2024):

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Special Considerations:
- Beach day at Waikiki Beach (June 11): Swimwear, beach towel, beach chair
- Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay (June 12): Snorkel equipment, rash guard
- Hiking at Diamond Head (June 13): Comfortable hiking shoes, water bottle
- Pearl Harbor visit (June 14): Comfortable walking shoes, notebook
- North Shore road trip (June 15): Sunscreen, hat, camera
- Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center (June 16): Casual dressy outfit
- Hotel spa relaxation (June 17): Bathrobe, comfortable clothing
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach (June 18): Swimwear, water shoes
- Shopping at Ala Moana Center (June 19): Shopping bags, comfortable shoes

Don't forget:
- Passport/ID
- Phone charger
- Airplane adapter if needed
- Travel insurance documents
- Emergency contact list
